verdict.rationale: Omnara is an agent-hosting and orchestration platform, so a repository agent-readiness capability is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never mentions agent-readiness criteria, scoring them, or automatically remediating failing ones. Generic features like skills, MCP tools and approvals are adjacent building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can automatically fix failing agent-readiness criteria in my repository
